# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
This is a simple HTML/CSS web project, originally based on the Spoon-Knife repository for demonstrating GitHub forking and collaboration workflows. The repository contains static web content and documentation files.

## Project Structure
- `index.html` - Main HTML page
- `styles.css` - CSS stylesheet
- `*.md` - Markdown documentation files
- `.github/` - GitHub configuration and metadata

## Coding Standards

### HTML
- Use HTML5 doctype
- Maintain consistent indentation (2 spaces)
- Use semantic HTML elements where appropriate
- Include proper meta tags in the `<head>` section
- Use descriptive alt text for images

### CSS
- Use consistent indentation (2 spaces)
- Follow a logical ordering of properties
- Use clear, descriptive selector names
- Prefer ID selectors for unique elements (#octocat)
- Use simple, maintainable selectors

### Markdown
- Follow standard Markdown formatting
- Use proper heading hierarchy (start with #, then ##, etc.)
- Keep lines reasonably short for readability
- Use code blocks with language identifiers when showing code examples

## File Naming Conventions
- Use lowercase with hyphens for HTML files: `index.html`
- Use lowercase with hyphens for CSS files: `styles.css`
- Use descriptive names for documentation: `family-court-dismissal-order.md`

## Best Practices
- Keep the project simple and maintainable
- Ensure all changes preserve the existing file structure
- Test HTML changes by opening files in a browser
- Validate HTML and CSS when making changes
- Maintain backward compatibility with existing links and references

## Ignored Files and Folders
- `.git/` - Git metadata
- Any temporary files or system files (`.DS_Store`, `Thumbs.db`)
